# Holton Le Clay Cars

> Holton Le Clay Cars is an independent used car dealer in Grimsby, North East Lincolnshire. We sell quality used cars, offer finance available subject to status, welcome part exchange, and include a minimum 3-month warranty with every car.

Based at Pinfold Lane, Holton-le-Clay, Grimsby DN36 5DH, we offer finance (credit broker, not a lender), part exchange, a minimum 3-month warranty with extended 6 and 12 month options, and 3 years free servicing and MOT tests (subject to East Grimsby MOT and Repair Centre Limited).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.holtonleclaycars.co.uk/): current stock overview, latest arrivals and highlights
- [Stock](https://www.holtonleclaycars.co.uk/stock.php): filter used cars by make, model, body type, fuel, price and mileage
- [Vehicle finance](https://www.holtonleclaycars.co.uk/finance.php): HP/PCP finance options from the representative APR, subject to status
- [Sell your car](https://www.holtonleclaycars.co.uk/sell-your-car.php): sell or part-exchange your car
- [Warranty](https://www.holtonleclaycars.co.uk/warranty.php): minimum 3-month warranty and extended cover options
- [Reviews](https://www.holtonleclaycars.co.uk/reviews.php): verified customer reviews
- [About us](https://www.holtonleclaycars.co.uk/about-us.php): independent dealer serving Grimsby and North East Lincolnshire
- [Contact](https://www.holtonleclaycars.co.uk/contact.php): call 07565 711773 or visit our Grimsby showroom
- [FAQ](https://www.holtonleclaycars.co.uk/faq.php): buying, finance, warranty and part exchange questions
- [Buyers guide](https://www.holtonleclaycars.co.uk/buyers-guide.php): step-by-step used car buying advice
- [Privacy policy](https://www.holtonleclaycars.co.uk/privacy.php)
